text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We secured a safe victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Just as promised,
I ran with the 2,000m in mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this up, we should have no problem
getting results in the next race as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, the time has finally come, Trainer-kun.
Let's go claim the Triple Crown—our absolute baseline.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —We're taking on the Satsuki Sho.

"Just as our plan to challenge
the Satsuki Sho was decided..."
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Um, President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you.
Well, how was my run?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
"...She carried herself with such majesty, it was wonderful.
The President really is just too amazing..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...?
Hey, you—

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...! Please excuse me!
(Patter-patter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No need for you to worry about it.
I'll contact them later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's do our review session while we can.
Time is precious, so we need to make good use of it.

Afterward, I held a brief review session
with Symboli Rudolf—
Upon returning to the academy...
(VROOM VRRRROOOOOM!! SKRRRRT!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? That flashy engine sound is...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hii, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky.
I knew it was you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, you know~
You're finally going for the Triple Crown, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Go and snag it with a
"Bang☆" for me, will you?♪

“The ‘Monster,’ Maruzensky. Debuting even before
Symboli Rudolf, she took the Umamusume world by storm—
also known as the ‘Supercar’...!”

The "Emperor" and the "Monster"—
seeing these two headliners side by side fills me with excitement as a Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Bang-bang... Bang-bang, huh?
Bang-bang...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a second...
You're thinking of a pun right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Even that's asking too much, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is nothing. It was simply quite a novel choice of words.
I thought it might be intriguing if I could put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, hey!
Don't go treating the way I talk like it's some freakish quirk~!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
I'm sorry.

...They seem to have quite a relaxed relationship.
Moreover, Symboli Rudolf looks somewhat at ease whenever she speaks with Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Oh no, the teacher called for me, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I parked in the staff lot for just a bit,
and it looks like they totally found out."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody was parked there anyway,
so who cares~?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ho, asking me whether that is right or wrong?
I don't mind answering, but what will you do?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoopsie...☆
Digging any deeper would be poking a hornet's nest, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, buh-bye!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
She's as lively as ever, isn't she?
choice_data_list: You two are pretty close, huh.
You two get along well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Rather than saying we're close friends...
I suppose you could say she's someone special to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As you know, she is invigorating the Umamusume world
with her overwhelming strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It means you're playing a part
as a contributor toward the ideal we strive for.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside...
I have a personal interest in it as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
In the sense that it stimulates one's instincts, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dreams, ideals, or perhaps the expectations of the students.
It is precisely because I have things to carry that I can become stronger.
Naturally, I believe that, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "If I were to compete against her with nothing but 100% pure fighting spirit, what would the outcome be...? Frankly, I am curious."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which of them is truly the stronger one, I wonder...

A fierce glint flashed in her eyes for a moment
as she spoke. But soon...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said,
in my current inexperienced state, it is beyond my reach."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must fulfill my duties.
I am returning to the Academy, but what about you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. There is always work to be done.
If there is nothing in particular, I shall take my leave.

Indeed, as she strives for her ideals today, even if she were to face Maruzensky,
she would surely wage battle in a manner befitting the "Emperor."

Separately from that, though...
it made me want to see her run as
"Symboli Rudolf" one day.
